backing.quote: إن أريد بالخيار السلطنة الفعلية... فلا يحدث إلا بعد ظهور الغبن
فهو ثابت قبل العلم، وإنما يتوقف على العلم إعمال هذا الحق

backing.component: روش: تبعیت هر اثر از دلیل خودش
backing.quote: والمتبع دليل كل واحد من تلك الآثار

per_athar_map.faskh_qabl_ilm: UNASSIGNED in text — posed as thamara (p.179) -> STOP-T3-A

nodes.statement: Khiyar has two meanings: (1) sultana fi'liyya — arises only after zuhur al-ghabn; (2) thubut haqq li-l-maghbun — exists from the 'aqd, only i'mal depends on 'ilm. Zuhur is kashif for (2), shart for (1). Ansari does not choose one globally; each athar follows its own dalil (pp.177-179).

backing.quote: فيما لو فسخ المغبون الجاهل اقتراحا أو بظن وجود سبب معدوم في الواقع فصادف الغبن

nodes.statement: Validity of the ignorant maghbun's faskh (iqtirāhan or believing in a non-existent cause) is posed by Ansari as the thamara of the two wujuh (p.179) and, within the searched scope (ghabn chapter; Irshad al-Talib reception pp.133-135 restates the fork as shart-shar'i vs kashif), no per-athar dalil assignment for faskh itself is given. Branches: mana-1 -> faskh ineffective (no sultana before zuhur); mana-2 -> right existed and the insha' attached to a real right. Engine must not pick a branch.

backing.quote: إذ يكفي في ذلك تحقق السبب المقتضي للخيار، وهو الغبن الواقعي وإن لم يعلم به

backing.component: عدم قدح اسقاط ما لم یتحقق
backing.quote: إذ لا مانع من ذلك إلا التعليق وعدم الجزم الممنوع عنه في العقود

nodes.statement: Isqat of the khiyar after the 'aqd and before zuhur al-ghabn is valid (al-zahir): it attaches to mana-2; realization of the sabab muqtadi (real ghabn) suffices; the 'isqat ma lam yajib' objection fails (the prohibited ta'liq is on what the insha's concept does not depend on). Analogies in text: ibra' al-wadi'i al-mufarrit; bara'a min al-'uyub qabl al-'ilm.

backing.quote: ولا مع الجهل بها إذا أسقط الغبن المسبب عن أي مرتبة كان، فاحشا كان أو أفحش

nodes.statement: Isqat whose insha' quantifies over the ghabn from ANY martaba (fahish or afhash) is valid without ishkal even with jahl bi-l-martaba; the tayb-nafs objection does not engage because the insha' itself covered the actual amount.

nodes.attribution: A (two wujuh presented); premise of wajh-2 endorsed by Ansari and reused at p.181 ('lamma dhakarna')

backing.component: وجه عدم طيب النفس + تشبیه قذف
backing.quote: من عدم طيب نفسه بسقوط هذا المقدار من الحق
ومن أن الخيار أمر واحد مسبب عن مطلق التفاوت الذي لا يتسامح به ولا تعدد فيه

nodes.statement: Isqat bila 'iwad made under a false belief about the martaba (believed 10, actual 100 in the text's mathal): suqut has an ishkal with two wujuh — (1) 'adam tayb al-nafs bi-suqut hadha al-miqdar (qadhf/shatm analogy); (2) al-khiyar amr wahid musabbab 'an mutlaq al-tafawut, la ta'addud fih, fa-yasqut bi-mujarrad al-isqat (and the qadhf analogy fails: qadhf and shatm are two different rights). No explicit tarjih for the bila-'iwad isqat case is stated on p.180.

backing.quote: ففي بطلان الصلح... أو صحته مع لزومه... أو صحته متزلزلا

nodes.statement: Sulh on the khiyar with itlaq that has a customary insiraf (text's mathal: bought for 20, customary probable disparity 4-5, settled for 1 dirham; actual disparity 18, item worth 2): three wujuh — butlan (lam yaqa' 'ala al-haqq al-mawjud); sihha+luzum (khiyar wahid, sabab wahid, afrad muta'addida); sihha mutazalzila (ghabn fi al-musalaha: the settled right proved worth more than its customary countervalue, and ghabn is ghabn whether jahl is in amount or in the 'ayn). Ansari: 'wa-hadha huwa al-aqwa' — the aqwa is the third wajh on the natural antecedent reading. Version caveat: the bracketed [fa-ta'ammal] (and [wujuh]) are absent in manuscript 'q' per the edition's footnotes; the aqwa statement itself is in the text.

backing.quote: فلا إشكال فيه مع العلم بمرتبة الغبن أو التصريح بعموم المراتب

nodes.statement: Sulh on the khiyar with explicit tasrih bi-'umum al-maratib (or 'ilm bi-l-martaba): valid and binding without ishkal.

backing.quote: المعتبر القيمة حال العقد، فلو زادت بعده ولو قبل اطلاع المغبون على النقصان حين العقد لم ينفع
لأن الزيادة إنما حصلت في ملكه والمعاملة وقعت على الغبن
ويحتمل عدم الخيار حينئذ، لأن التدارك حصل قبل الرد
كما لو برئ المعيب قبل الاطلاع على عيبه

nodes.force: zahir (main line) + recorded unadopted ihtimal + harder sub-case left as ashkal (rise before qabd where milk is qabd-contingent)
nodes.statement: The criterion is the value at 'aqd time. A later increase, even before the maghbun learns of the original shortfall, does not remove the khiyar: the increase accrued in his own ownership and the transaction occurred upon ghabn. Recorded counter-ihtimal (NOT adopted): no khiyar because tadarak occurred before radd, analogized to a defect cured before knowledge (Tadhkira: radd falls whenever the 'ayb disappears before radd).
